Each Aeon is associated with a Path, by which they can use its energy as they please, but they are also bound to it for the rest of their lives.

Aeons are the Godlike of their own Path but now Aeons that still exist have 7 Aeons[Nanook: Path of Destruction, Lan: Path of the Hunt, Nous: Path of Erudition, Xipe: Path of Harmony, IX: Path of Nihility, Qlipoth: Path of Preservation, Yaoshi: Path of Abundance.])
